prompt: Which nation most recently joined the trillion-dollar economy club, with a nominal GDP exceeding $1 trillion per year?
answer: Taiwan most recently joined the trillion-dollar economy club, with its nominal GDP estimated at about **$1.02 trillion in 2026**. (Poland and Switzerland joined in 2025.)
